concept.material: patinated gunmetal and polished copper wire
concept.internal_detail: intricate brass gear trains and hairline tension springs
concept.button: a small spring-loaded brass stud set into the corner
concept.shell_mechanic: The heavy gunmetal ingot splits down its median groove and the two ridged halves slide outward along internal brass tracks
concept.emerging_parts: Four jointed copper legs, a long segmented snout, and two floppy metal ear flaps
concept.signature_move: its articulated metal ears pivot forward on their pins and its hinged copper jaw drops open and clicks shut
concept.turkish: Basset hound (uzun kulakli ve sarkik yuzlu av kopegi) — oluklu eskenar dortgen kulce, patinajli tuncdan yapilmis govde ve parlatilmis bakir tel
